title: Miguelópolis: Vanilla+
description: Enhancing the Minecraft experience without losing the vanilla essence!
body:
# Miguelópolis: Vanilla+
Miguelópolis: Vanilla+ is a meticulously curated modpack designed for players who feel that base Minecraft has untapped potential. We’ve avoided the clutter of complex machinery and outlandish magic to focus on what matters: immersion, performance, and exploration, all while preserving the core soul of the game.

Whether you are a master builder, a technical player, or a casual explorer, Miguelópolis enhances every second of your journey.

## 🟢 Unrivaled Performance
Experience Minecraft smoother than ever before. By integrating a powerhouse suite of optimization mods—including Sodium, Lithium, and BadOptimizations—we’ve ensured high frame rates and stable tick times.

Entity Culling and Better Block Entities keep your FPS high even in dense areas.

Reese's Sodium Options and Sodium Extra give you granular control over your graphical overhead.

## ✨ Visual Refinement & Atmosphere
The world feels alive. We’ve breathed new life into every entity and environment without breaking the "Vanilla" aesthetic.

Life in Motion: Featuring Fresh Animations (including Emissive support) and Theone's Eating Animations, mobs now move with personality.

Atmospheric Depth: From Particle Rain and Simple Water to the beautiful Skyboxify and BiomeBloom, the environment reacts to your presence.

Dynamic Lighting: LambDynamicLights and Iris Shaders support ensure your torches and world glow with realistic warmth.

## 🛠️ The Ultimate Builder’s Toolkit
For the creators, we’ve included the industry-standard tools to bring your visions to life effortlessly.

Precision Tools: Full support for Axiom, WorldEdit, and Litematica for massive projects or micro-detailing.

Utility & Ease: Freecam, Camera Utils, and Fabrishot allow you to document your builds with cinematic flair.

Quality of Life: ItemSwapper, Big Sign Writer, and Scribble make the building process intuitive rather than tedious.

## 🧭 Seamless Exploration & UI
Navigating your world is now a premium experience.

Intelligent UI: Xaero’s World Map helps you find your way, while Shulker Box Tooltip, BetterF3, and Chat Heads keep information clean and accessible.

Inventory Perfection: Mouse Tweaks, Client Sort, and Trade Cycling remove the "inventory tetris" headache.

Progression: Track your journey with Advancements Reloaded and Fancy Toasts, adding a satisfying polish to every milestone.
